name: Reading International, Inc.
summary: Reading International, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, focuses on the ownership, development, and operation of entertainment and real property assets in the United States, Australia, and New Zealand. It operates in two segments, Cinema Exhibition and Real Estate. The Cinema Exhibition segment operates cinemas. The Real Estate segment develops, rents, or licenses retail, commercial, and live theater assets.
